meta.name: tam-sam-som-calculator
meta.description: Calculate TAM, SAM, and SOM with explicit assumptions, methods, and caveats. Use when sizing a market for a product idea, business case, or executive review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算市场规模，明确假设与方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要估算产品市场机会并展示给决策者。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate market size with clear assumptions and methods.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to estimate product market opportunity for stakeholders.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你逐步计算 TAM、SAM 和 SOM，通过提问收集产品信息、地理区域、行业和客户群体，最后生成带数据来源和假设的市场规模分析报告。
howto.when: 当你需要为产品创意、商业案例或高管评审估算市场规模时，可以主动要求 Claude 计算 TAM/SAM/SOM。

say.text: 帮我算一下AI排班助手在美国牙科诊所的市场规模。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，逐步计算 TAM/SAM/SOM。

say.text: 计算TAM/SAM/SOM：面向中小企业的SaaS工具，全球市场。
say.note: Claude 会询问更多细节后生成分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you step-by-step to calculate TAM, SAM, and SOM by asking questions about product idea, geography, industry, and customer segments, then generates a structured market size analysis with data sources and assumptions.
howto.when_en: Use when sizing a market for a product idea, business case, or executive review. Invoke by asking Claude to calculate TAM/SAM/SOM.

say_en.text: Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM for an AI scheduling assistant for US dental practices.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to compute the market sizes.

say_en.text: Market sizing: B2B SaaS for SMBs, global market.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for more details and generate the analysis.
